answer: Each identity docks at a wharf, posts a 70-credit bond, registers a violet seal. Each epoch it settles ten trades with ten distinct partners, each taking an oasis share, bearing a violet seal. Auditors replay the wharf ledger and oasis pool: a set trading only within itself is a closed clique; bond slashed. First 40; kth fake 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes: 3,037,000 + 70,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. Rented-partner rings fail; honest agents pay 40 once.
